title: Google Play App & Reviews Scraper input

appIds.title: Android package IDs
appIds.description: Android application package IDs to collect, such as com.instagram.android. Each valid ID produces one public app metadata record.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code used for the Google Play storefront, such as US, GB, KR, or DE.

language.title: Language
language.description: Google Play interface language code used for app text and reviews, such as en, ko, or de.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Maximum newest reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Maximum newest public reviews to save for each successful app. Set 0 to collect app metadata only.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Enabled by default because Google can rate-limit data-center traffic; the Actor rotates proxy sessions during longer runs.
